cues: Malus's law only applies to light that is already polarized.
When unpolarized light meets the first Polaroid, its vibrations point in every direction at random, and the average of cos squared over all directions is a half.
So the first sheet always lets through exactly half, whichever way it is turned.
Only after that does cos squared theta apply.
